fusions.name: Spotting Peck
fusions.desc: A peck from a distance that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at the full 5 tiles, with a 30% chance of leaving the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Stretch
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Runs it down for 20 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut Off
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 7 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Blooded Pursuit
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
